preprocessing.steps: split on whitespace; escape @<>!()&|:'\; append :* to every atom; join atoms with &
preprocessing.sqlalchemy: SQLAlchemy 1.4.54; its 1.4 PostgreSQL dialect emits to_tsquery for match()

boolean.operators: each whitespace atom is conjoined with AND after source preprocessing
boolean.words: OR, AND, and NOT are ordinary simple-dictionary terms, not operator keywords
boolean.punctuation: &, |, !, parentheses, angle brackets, colon, quote, and backslash are escaped
boolean.precedence: not_applicable; there are no caller Boolean operators after preprocessing
boolean.live_contrast: satellite OR debris was native zero for Events while satellite was positive

wildcards.status: source_prefix_processing; no separate UI wildcard contract
wildcards.source_behavior: the source appends the PostgreSQL :* prefix marker to every atom
wildcards.trailing_asterisk: raw * is preserved; satellite* matched the same three event paths as satellite
wildcards.bounded_other_positions: *satellite and satellite%/satellite_ matched that same bounded event set, while sat*lite differed; no portable general glob grammar is claimed
wildcards.adapter_policy: preserve raw q and never synthesize, broaden, or locally interpret wildcard forms

variants.dictionary: simple lowercases tokens; it does not provide stemming or synonym expansion
variants.automatic_plurals: not provided; satellite matched Satellites only because the shorter source prefix was applied
variants.live_contrast: satellite returned event 387; satellites did not; analysis and analyses also diverged
variants.scope: behavior outside the simple configuration and tested prefix relations is unknown

hyphen_space.status: not normalized by the adapter or source whitespace split
hyphen_space.source_behavior: space-debris remains one preprocessor atom; PostgreSQL parses hyphenated tokens/parts
hyphen_space.live_contrast: space debris returned nine Events while space-debris returned native zero for Events

phrases.live_contrast: space debris and double-quoted space debris returned the same nine first-page event paths

proximity.operators: the source escapes < and > before joining atoms, so <-> is not exposed as FOLLOWED BY
proximity.counting: no token-distance, slop, or proximity count is returned by the UI
proximity.live_contrast: space <-> debris matched the same bounded event paths as space debris

date.source_fields: date fields are not part of unqualified q for any current group
date.live_contrast: event 387 displayed a 2021 date but was absent from q=2021; q=2021 matched titles containing 2021
